maddeler.e:
امتعضن (form VIII)
# اِمْتَعَضْنَ (imtaʕaḍna) /im.ta.ʕadˤ.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِمْتَعَضَ (imtaʕaḍa)
# اُمْتُعِضْنَ (umtuʕiḍna) /um.tu.ʕidˤ.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِمْتَعَضَ (imtaʕaḍa)
# اِمْتَعِضْنَ (imtaʕiḍna) /im.ta.ʕidˤ.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِمْتَعَضَ (imtaʕaḍa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
